title: Smaller, faster, safer: running Kimi and GLM at scale
summary: Cloudflare is deploying smaller, efficient AI models like Kimi and GLM on their global edge network, optimizing for faster inference, lower latency, and enhanced security through their Workers AI platform.
problem_solved: Enables running AI inference at global edge scale with significantly reduced latency and improved performance compared to traditional centralized cloud deployments.
why_valuable: Makes AI capabilities more accessible and cost-effective by leveraging edge infrastructure, benefiting developers and end-users with faster response times worldwide.
